quest.title: Theater Mechanicus
quest.description: You discover someone who is currently promoting Theater Mechanicus in Inazuma...

dialogues.speaker: Komakata
dialogues.text: Come, try your hand at Theater Mechanicus!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: W—Welcome! I am a local representative for this new game from Liyue. It's called Theater Mechanicus!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: In short, it is a game that can be played on a board. It was first invented by Ms. Ruijin from Liyue.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Well, according to Ms. Ruijin, I am one of their overseas agents.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: After I obtained... umm... the distribution rights, Ms. Ruijin sent me a complete set of Theater Mechanicus and the business model that goes with it.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Although it initially got confiscated by the Outlander Affairs Agency... It took me a while to get this copy of the game back.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why did the Outlander Affairs Agency confiscate this...

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Anyway. Let's not talk about this.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Do you see these things laid out on the table here? These are all important items used in Theater Mechanicus.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Does it feel like Liyue? Hahaha, this version was tailor-made according to the descriptions in Ms. Ruijin's letter.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I even had someone make this table... It cost me a fortune.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: And per Ms. Ruijin's suggestions, I added new features to Theater Mechanicus.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Well... Anyway, it's better to learn through practice. Why don't you just give it a go? You'll understand after you play it.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Sure thing! Enjoy the brand-new version of Theater Mechanicus! You won't be disappointed!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Well, try it when you're free next time.

choices.text: How come there's Theater Mechanicus here...

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Welcome... Huh? So you know Theater Mechanicus?

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Ah... I see. You must've played it in Liyue before.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Ms. Ruijin told me that she promoted the game during the Lantern Rite... So it did work after all.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Well, according to Ms. Ruijin, I'm a local representative of Theater Mechanicus in Inazuma.
